WITH SourceData AS
(SELECT CASP.CustomerAccountId,
SUM(CASP.EndValue)/COUNT(DC.AccountID) AS avgBalanceAmount,
FORMAT(CASP.DateStamp, 'yyyyMMdd') AS DateStamp
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio CASP
INNER JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount AS DC ON CASP.CustomerAccountId = DC.AccountID
WHERE DC.ShareIndicator = 'Y'
GROUP BY CASP.CustomerAccountId, DateStamp, EndValue),

TargetData AS
(SELECT AccountID, BusinessDateSK, PortfolioEndValueProrated_Original
FROM DW.FACTSECURITYPORTFOLIO_UT_20230914)

SELECT 
S.CustomerAccountId AS SourceAccountID, T.AccountID AS TargetAccountID, S.avgBalanceAmount AS SourceAmount, T.PortfolioEndValueProrated_Original AS TargetAmount, S.DateStamp AS SourceDate, T.BusinessDateSK AS TargetDate
FROM SourceData S
LEFT JOIN TargetData T ON S.CustomerAccountId = T.AccountId AND S.DateStamp = T.BusinessDateSK
WHERE S.avgBalanceAmount <> T.PortfolioEndValueProrated_Original
